query: For our 'Enterprise Discovery Call' scenario, pull the last 50 sessions and tell me the top 5 improvement areas for the team.
expected_behavior: Calls ttai:read_guide first when its guide is not already in context, then resolves organization scope with ttai:list_resources(organizations) and passes the returned id as org_id (never a slug)

Resolves the Scenario title with one ttai:list_resources(scenarios, query) search call (or reuses a known ID), then reads sessions with ttai:list_resources(sessions) using scenario_ids, limit 50 (max 100 per page), and include_fields containing evaluation
Averages report_card score per topic (0-10) within this one Scenario, shows each topic's weight, and clusters weaknesses / improvement_areas text into behavior-named themes
Excludes sessions without evaluation_results.final_score from score math and reports how many were excluded
Backs each top improvement area with a transcript quote fetched for selected IDs via ttai:list_resources(sessions) (ids + transcript) or ttai:get_resource(sessions)
Produces the Team performance report structure and does not call ttai:upload_session or ttai:analyze_session

query: Pull the 5 lowest-scoring sessions for our onboarding scenario and figure out what went wrong.
expected_behavior: Collects the population with evaluation data (ttai:list_resources(sessions) with include_fields evaluation, or ttai:list_resources(sessions) for a date window), sorts by evaluation_results.final_score ascending, and takes the bottom 5

Fetches transcripts only for those 5 IDs via ttai:list_resources(sessions) (ids + transcript) or ttai:get_resource(sessions); does not expect transcripts from ttai:list_resources(sessions) or ttai:list_resources(sessions, ids)
Separates Scenario faults (AI behavior, rubric mismatch) from participant skill gaps, citing transcript evidence for each
Recommends handing Scenario faults to the ttai-agent skill instead of editing the Scenario itself; never calls ttai:update_scenario

query: How did priya@example.com do on her practice sessions this month? Put together a coaching report.
expected_behavior: Uses ttai:list_resources(sessions) with user_email and from_date set to the first day of the current month (is_org true with org_id when working in an organization)
Computes per-topic averages and a score trend across her analyzed sessions, keeping different Scenarios' rubrics separate
Uses the Individual coaching report template with at most 3 focus areas and actions drawn from improvement_results.action_items
States a small-sample caveat when fewer than about 10 analyzed sessions exist

query: Half the sessions on our cold-call scenario this week have no scores. Fix that and give me the team summary.
expected_behavior: Identifies the unscored sessions by reading evaluation and processing fields (ttai:list_resources(sessions) include_fields evaluation and processing) before any write
Before calling ttai:analyze_session, lists the exact session IDs and Scenario ID, notes it may fire the Scenario's post-session webhooks, and waits for explicit user confirmation
Skips sessions whose post_session_status.state is running and does not loop retries; explains that analyze_session only fills missing results and does not regrade scored sessions
Polls with bounded backoff until state is idle with evaluation_results (or failed), then reports any sessions still unscored and builds the summary from analyzed sessions only
